propositions: dc_store_copy_repo fixture fails on git fetch with exit 128 but discards git's stderr, making the root cause undiagnostic
subprocess.run calls in the fixture pair capture_output=True with check=True, which raises CalledProcessError whose string representation omits the captured stderr output
git fetch, archive, and ls-tree calls in the fixture lack retry logic on transient failures and are undiagnosed when they fail
a new run_git helper must capture stderr, perform explicit error checking, and raise RuntimeError carrying the command, exit status, and verbatim stderr for all three git call sites
fetch_tickets helper must retry the fetch operation a bounded number of times with backoff before final failure, maintaining retry-then-fail semantics so genuine misconfigurations still fail the test
